difference: Old single_unfold_triangle_binding paired one diagonal to D and treated a crease as its base (D preset); crease_axes_as_hole_edges paired two crease directions to C (C preset). Both returned E/E. New B relation compares four slants at two outer-border notches with the actual cut, targeting boundary-location versus central-hole mapping. It does not recolor a fold edge, does not retain either old receiver or tested PNG, and does not merely change an option letter in the same local feature matching.
